author: Bobby Grayson
description: Type-directed decisions in the translator: variable at Option position already bound at base type -> some x' with guard; nil at Option -> none; atom at enum type -> constructor; {:noreply, v} with v : Int at Option Int -> some v. Guards become if-then-else with fallthrough to the next subsuming clause; subsumed clauses are dropped since Lean rejects redundant alternatives.
title: The @type declarations were sufficient as the type oracle: Option wrapping, none/nil, list cons, enum atoms, and the non-linear pattern {p, [n|rest]} all resolved from types alone. No @spec needed beyond msg/state
